findings.text: cpu_provenance_marker was rewritten to a generic 'CPU lane retained from the original sirius run' where the base revision recorded why the lane is CPU at all (the gpu_0003_grpA reservation admitting no job while the node was idle); the brief asked to keep the lane's recorded rationale, and the replacement drops it while leaving the rest of the receipt honest.

the tests line carries a 'timeout 900' prefix that the gate log's own '# command:' header (panel-gate.log:3) does not, so the literal command recorded is not the literal command that ran; promotion reads its receipt from this line.

every guard on the regenerated schema (the required-key set here, the clipped/overlapping label asserts at 79-80, the receipt-revision assert comparing 48d7adda6 as an independent literal) lives in a run-directory script that disappears after the run, so nothing in the repository reddens if the committed state reverts to the pre-regeneration schema; no test under tests/ reads docs/figures/mast-centroid-capability.

the caption states the conductor-only panel has no reference null set, but the binding poloidal plotting rule requires every panel that draws flux to mark the magnetic axis and admitted X-points; the regenerated conductor-only panel (rendered from the head SVG) draws contours with no null markers and the rule says such a figure is regenerated rather than captioned around, though a fix would need a producer source change outside this node's write paths.
